shared_or_similar_visual_information: A straight boundary separating the shaded and unshaded parts of a coordinate plane. Compare the horizontal line between the gray and white regions in the left image with the diagonal line between the gray and white regions in the right image.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The horizontal equality boundary is included in the shaded solution region. Right image: The equality line belongs to the shaded solution region.
Rationales: Each region has a solid boundary, so points satisfying equality belong to both depicted solution sets along their respective lines.
